description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans serialization support related to the .NET ISerializable interface. It verifies correct serialization, deserialization, and callback invocation for objects implementing ISerializable, including classes and structs with various serialization scenarios.

classes.name: Orleans.Serialization.UnitTests.SimpleISerializableObject
classes.description: A serializable class implementing ISerializable and IDeserializationCallback, used to test custom serialization callbacks and history tracking of serialization events.

classes.name: Orleans.Serialization.UnitTests.SimpleISerializableStruct
classes.description: A serializable struct implementing ISerializable and IDeserializationCallback, used to test struct serialization with callbacks and history tracking.

classes.name: Orleans.Serialization.UnitTests.UnserializableConformingException
classes.description: A custom exception class conforming to ISerializable, used in serialization tests, with custom serialization logic and fields.

classes.name: Orleans.Serialization.UnitTests.UnserializableNonConformingException
classes.description: A simple subclass of Exception, used to test serialization behavior for non-conforming exception types.

classes.name: Orleans.Serialization.UnitTests.BaseException
classes.description: A base exception class providing serialization constructors and GetObjectData implementation, used as a base for custom exception types.

methods.name: SerializationLoop
methods.description: A method performing serialization and deserialization of an object through Orleans serialization pipeline, verifying consistency and recording the process.

methods.name: ISerializableObjectWithCallbacks
methods.description: Test method verifying the serialization callbacks and history for a class implementing ISerializable.

methods.name: ISerializableStructWithCallbacks
methods.description: Test method verifying the serialization callbacks and history for a struct implementing ISerializable.

methods.name: Serialize_UnserializableException
methods.description: Test method verifying serialization and deserialization of known and unknown exception types, including properties.
